info.description: Search-engine and social-share metadata. Field names mirror the HTML meta tags they map to.

metaTitle.description: Browser tab title and the headline in search results. Under 60 characters so it is not truncated.

metaDescription.description: The summary shown beneath the title in search results. Under 160 characters so it is not truncated.

ogImage.description: Preview image used when the page is shared on social media. 1200x630 pixels works best.

ogImageAlt.description: Describes the share image for screen readers. Fill this in whenever a share image is set.

noIndex.description: Hides the page from search engines. Leave this ON - the original design belongs to its creators.
